home.goalsBody:
To establish an exemplary educational institution by integrating revelation-based (divine) education with secular (worldly) education, supported by a unique and comprehensive curriculum.

To play a leading role—for the benefit of the nation, the people, and global society—in implementing an ethical, life-oriented, and work-focused educational system, while effectively rooting out both secular education devoid of moral values and religious education devoid of practical application.

To play a pioneering role in building a nation grounded in human values by transforming the fragile global education system—improving core educational frameworks at both national and international levels, and integrating co-curricular activities alongside other vocationally-oriented educational approaches.
home.beaconBody:
Respected and conscientious parents! Every child is the finest and most precious asset of their family—a treasure trove of immense potential, and a rising sun on the horizon of the future. How do you wish to nurture this cherished child of yours? Do you desire for them to be enriched with the knowledge of Divine Revelation (Wahi) while also receiving a modern, state-of-the-art education—ultimately becoming an exemplary guide on both national and international stages?

What is it that you desire? Do you wish for someone to be proficient in their mother tongue (Bengali), the language of the Quran (Arabic), and the international language (English), while also being imbued with strong moral values? Currently, due to a fragmented, three-tiered education system—comprising the general, Qawmi, and Alia Madrasa streams—this noble aspiration remains merely an aspiration, never becoming a reality.

Thus, the 'Three Languages, Four Skills-based Ideal Global Qur'anic School' has been established and is operated based on a unique curriculum and syllabus that integrates these elements. It can serve as a beacon of hope for navigators like you, amidst a sea of profound darkness.
home.visionBody: To raise knowledgeable, ethical, and confident students — rooted in the Qur'an and ready to serve their families, the ummah, and the nation.
home.missionBody: To give excellent Qur'anic and general education in a safe, spiritually rich school, and to partner with families in the tarbiyah of every child.
home.dreamsBody: Those hopes are worked out in class. The syllabus stays short and rich. From the earliest grades, children follow the general course and, alongside it, memorise the Qur'an and learn to translate it into Bangla and English. Arabic and English conversation and speaking receive special care. The day's lesson is finished in the classroom. Handwriting, mathematics, and basic computer skills are taught with attention. Weekly and monthly tests make progress clear, and competitions and wholesome cultural programmes develop talent. Qualified, trained teachers teach, with guidance from scholars at home and abroad.
home.gainBody: Your child learns in three languages — Bangla, Arabic, and English — and is trained in the four skills of each: listening, speaking, reading, and writing. With the general curriculum they gain fluent recitation, the ability to understand and translate the Qur'an, and the confidence to speak and present in Arabic and English. One vision holds it together: knowledge, character, and a brighter future.
home.holisticBody: A child needs education that holds the whole person, not only examination marks. IGQS attends to salah and the Sunnah as a lived practice for teachers and students, to modest conduct, to a clean campus, to healthy recreation, and to programmes that develop talent. Boys and girls study in separate sections, and shar'i modesty is part of the school day.
home.facilitiesBody: Beyond the classroom, students need quiet space for the Qur'an, room to play, a place for prayer, and programmes that develop talent and character. Facility details appear here as the school publishes them.
home.procedure1: Read the fees, monthly tuition, and uniform notes on this page.
home.procedure2: Choose your child's class and complete the online application.
home.procedure3: Pay the admission fee using one of the online payment methods.
home.procedure4: Enter the transaction ID and upload a photo of the payment.
home.procedure5: Submit the form, save the receipt, and follow the application while the school verifies the payment.
home.tuitionBody: Monthly tuition depends on the class and on the Bangla or English section. The school office confirms the current monthly fee for your child's class before admission is finalised. Please ask the office for the latest figure for that class.
home.paymentsEmpty: Pay through bKash, Nagad, Rocket, or a bank transfer, then enter the transaction ID and upload a photo of the payment in the application. Account details appear here when the school publishes a payment method.
home.uniformBody: Students attend in the school uniform. Boys and girls have separate, modest dress. The office gives the current uniform list, including shoes and hijab guidance for girls, when a place is confirmed.
home.feesIntro: These are the admission and session fees currently set by the school. A class without its own amount uses the school-wide fee.
home.feeScheduleIntro: Bangla version and English version. Admission is paid once. The session fee is charged every year. Monthly tuition is separate, and Pre-Hifz and Hifz is an extra monthly charge where it is shown. The online application collects the one-time admission fee.
home.feesEmpty: The office confirms the admission and session fee for the current session. Apply online, or call the school, for the figure that applies to your child's class.
home.howToApplyBody: Fill in the form, then add your bKash transaction ID and a photo of the payment.
